articles.summary: Company receives Class VI injection well draft permit from U.S. EPA Generated $1.06 of net income per share in Fiscal Q2 ’26 vs. $0.22 of net income per share in Fiscal Q2 ‘25 Reported gross profit of $53.3 million for Fiscal Q2 ’26 vs. $14.3 million in Fiscal Q2 ‘25 Reported Net Income to REX
articles.title: REX American Resources Reports Record Fiscal Second Quarter 2026 Net Income Per Share Attributable to REX Common Shareholders of $1.06 vs. $0.22 in Fiscal Second Quarter 2025
